description.en:
Sets the match period and the match clock. Story matches use it after a scripted beat to jump to a given moment, for example straight to the second half.

The clock is the one CMND_BTL_GET_MATCH_TIME reads, in seconds (the engine stores it in hundredths). The scripts treat it as time within the current half: they log a goal at minute 5 of the second half with CMND_BTL_SET_POINT_HISTORY(1, 1, 5, ...) and then set (1, 300).
It also raises the progress milestone read by CMND_BTL_GET_MATCHPHASE: to 100 for period 0 and to 300 for periods 1 to 4 (the milestone never goes down).
Not to be confused with CMND_BTL_SET_MATCHPHASE, which writes that milestone directly.
Match period: 0 = first half, 1 = second half (the shipped scripts only use these two).
Match clock to set, in seconds (60 = 1:00, 300 = 5:00, 1200 = 20:00). The scripts use values from 0 to 1830.
